responsibility: Declares MacroInvocLexer, the token-source wrapper used by the Rust parser when reading macro invocation and transcriber token streams instead of normal source text. It owns a vector of AST::Token objects and exposes the parser-facing primitives for peeking, skipping, splitting combined punctuation tokens for nested generic closers, reporting the current offset, and extracting token slices, making it the bridge between macro-expanded token buffers and ordinary parser logic.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the lightweight lexer adapter type used by the parser for macro-produced token vectors, including its constructor, parser-facing API, and stored stream/offset state. The corresponding .cc file implements the actual token access and slice-extraction operations.
